basics.name: Max Manuel C.A.
basics.label: Full Stack Developer | React · Next.js · TypeScript · Node.js | 6+ Years of Experience | Open to Remote
basics.summary: Full Stack Developer with 6+ years of experience building high-performance, accessible, and SEO-optimized web applications. Specialized in Front-end development with React, Next.js, Angular, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and SCSS. Back-end experience with Node.js, PHP (Laravel), and Python, designing and consuming RESTful APIs and scalable solutions. Solid knowledge of relational and non-relational databases including MySQL, SQL Server, MariaDB, and MongoDB. Proficient with CI/CD tools and DevOps workflows using Docker, Git, Jenkins, GitLab, and Bitbucket. CMS expertise with WordPress, WooCommerce, Joomla, and Drupal. Familiar with Agile/Scrum methodologies. Design and prototyping skills with Figma, Illustrator, and Photoshop.
